passage:
On Friday afternoon, SpaceX's Starship took off from its base in Texas, near the U.S.A. and Mexico. Starship is the world's largest and strongest rocket. It is 124 meters tall. This was its 15th flight since 2023, but only its second trip around the Earth.

The rocket has two parts. The bottom part helps it take off, and the top part goes into space. After the two parts came off from each other, the top part sent out 26 Starlink machines. It stayed about 265 kilometers above the Earth and went around it 14 times. On the trip before this one, it went around only once or twice.

The bottom part did not have a good day. On its way back down, its engines stopped too early. It knew it was in the wrong place, so it turned away over the water and broke into pieces. Pieces of it were left in the sea near Mexico, and engineers are still trying to find out why.

The top part did much better. On Saturday, 22 hours after it left, it came back to the same place it took off from. Giant arms on the tower caught it in the air. It was the first time a Starship coming back from space was caught this way. SpaceX said the part for heat seemed to work well. Elon Musk said it was a great day. He even hugged it.

Catching a rocket means it can be used again, and this makes space travel faster and cheaper. SpaceX had hoped to catch both parts this time, but it caught only one. Still, it had already caught the bottom part three times before.

NASA is paying thousands of millions of dollars for Starship to carry people to the moon. The head of NASA said, "It was almost magic." NASA hopes to land people on the moon as soon as 2028. That would be the first moon landing in more than 50 years. Musk has a bigger dream: he wants to build a city on Mars.
options: A new rocket base that SpaceX is building in Mexico
Starship's top part was caught after a trip around the Earth, but its bottom part was lost
Why NASA decided to stop working with SpaceX
How people live on the moon
explain: 正解是選項二。全文在講 Starship 飛到太空、上面那一節回來時被塔上的巨大手臂接住，但下面那一節在回程時在水面上方裂成碎片。選項一：起飛的基地在 Texas，文章沒說要在墨西哥蓋基地。選項三：NASA 還在付很多錢給 Starship，沒有停止合作。選項四：文章沒有談人們怎麼在月球生活。
